name: Lin Chunxiang
source:
Chunxiang is a young girl whom Lucia met through Shuang as they seem to be pretty close with each other.

The reason as to why Chunxiang spends most of her time confined in a hospital is unknown; however, Lucia assumes that she is terminally ill.

Despite living under these conditions, Chunxiang still remains optimistic and doesn't seem to complain about her current situation. She is shown to have a friendly nature as she didn't have any problems with Lucia upon their first meeting.
